sections.shortTitle: Sindh Landing and Wharfage Fees Act 1882
sections.description:
Powers, privileges and liabilities of officers who collect fees

SIND ACT No
SIND ACT No. VII
OF 1882
[*[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see B.G.G., 1881, Pt.
V. P. 41; and for Proceedings in Council, see ibid, p. 47:]]
[THE SIND LANDING
AND WHARFAGE, FEES ACT, 1882.]
[18th November,
1882]
An Act to provide
for the levy of fees for the use of Public Landing-places.
7. Powers, privileges and
liabilities of officers who collect fees. The officers and person's whose
duty it may be to levy fees under this Act shall have the same powers for
collecting and enforc ing payment of the same as are exercisable under the
provisions of any law, for the time being in force, in respect of duties of sea -customs
by the Collector of Customs and his subordinates, and shall have the same
privileges and be subject to the same liabilities in respect of anything done
by them in collecting and enforcing pay ment of the said fees as the said
Collector of Customs and his sub ordinates have, or are liable to, under the
provisions of any such law.
Punishment of offenders. The
law for the time being in force for the punishment of offences relating to the
levy or payment of duties of sea-customs, and for the reward of informers,
shall, as far as may be, apply to similar offences committed in respect of the
said fees.
*[In particular and without prejudice
to the generality of the provisions of the foregoing paragraph, the penalty
prescribed in the third column of article I of section 167 of the **Sea Customs Act, 1878, shall be leviable in respect
of the contravention of any bye law made under this Act. VIII of 1878.]
*[This para ins. by the Sind Landing and
Wharfage Fees (Amedt.) Act, 1916 (Sind 5 of 1916), s. 4.]
**[Now see the Customs Act, 1969.]

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Landing and Wharfage Fees Act 1882
sections.description:
Fees realised under this Act how to be expended

SIND ACT No
SIND ACT No. VII
OF 1882
[*[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see B.G.G., 1881, Pt.
V. P. 41; and for Proceedings in Council, see ibid, p. 47:]]
[THE SIND LANDING
AND WHARFAGE, FEES ACT, 1882.]
[18th November,
1882]
An Act to provide
for the levy of fees for the use of Public Landing-places.
*[10. Fees realised under this
Act how to be expended. **[In any port to
which this Act applies expenditure incurred under any of the following heads
shall be deemed for the purposes of the next succeeding section to be
expenditure under this Act, for the port, that is to say, expenditure-]
**[Subs. by the A.O., 1937, for "The proceeds of all fees realized under this Act shall be
emended in any port to which this Act applies".]
(a) in payment
of the expenses of the administration of this Act;
(b) in defraying
the cost of acquiring or constructing new landing-places required for the
convenience of the traffic or trade of such port;
(c) in
maintaining and improving any existing landing place and in constructing,
maintaining or providing waiting rooms and other convenience or facilities for
passengers, and generally in the improvement of such port; and
(d) in payment
of the charges connected with the establishing, maintaining and working of
telegraphs and telephones between any such ports.]
*[Subs. by Sind 5
of 1916, s. 6, for the original section 10.]

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Landing and Wharfage Fees Act 1882
sections.description:
Receipt, expenditure and account of landing and wharfage fees

SIND ACT No
SIND ACT No. VII
OF 1882
[*[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see B.G.G., 1881, Pt.
V. P. 41; and for Proceedings in Council, see ibid, p. 47:]]
[THE SIND LANDING
AND WHARFAGE, FEES ACT, 1882.]
[18th November,
1882]
An Act to provide
for the levy of fees for the use of Public Landing-places.
*[11. Receipt, expenditure and
account of landing and wharfage fees. (1) For each port to which this Act
applies a distinct account, to be called the landing and wharfage fees fund
account, shall be kept showing, in such detail as the Chief Customs-authority
prescribes, the receipts and expenditure under this Act for the port.]
*[S.11 added by Sind 5 of 1916, s. 7.]
An abstract of the account for
the past financial year, in such form as the Chief Customs-authority
prescribes, shall be published annually as soon after the first day of April as
may be practicable.
(2) If an advance of money shall
be made by the Government for any of the purpose of this Act, on account of any
port to which this Act applies, simple interest on that advance or upon so much
of it as shall remain un-repaid, at such rate as *[Government]
may determine, shall be chargeable in the landing and wharfage fees fund
account of such port.
*[Subs. by the A.
O., 1937, for "the G. in C."]
(3) All monies received under
this Act at or on account of any port to which this Act applies shall be
credited in the landing and wharfage fees fund account of the port.
(4) *[* * * * * * *]
*[Sub-section (4) omitted ibid.]
